manifest.note: One manifest literal; catalog.php reports the tool with zero errors and zero warnings under the staged project-delivery catalog.

framework_scripts.note: site-disclaimer.js, diagram-common.js, diagram-ui.js and diagram-project.js load deferred, each with one version anchor.

localisation.note: 270 positional seven-language calls, none with an empty slot and none with Cyrillic in the English slot.

mobile_desktop.note: Rendered at 390x844 and 1440x900 in en, uk and pl with no root horizontal overflow.

permalink_round_trip.note: 45 boundaries and 135 items over 10 packages survive a 7363-character permalink opened in a fresh browser context; every side-A/side-B pair matches.

permalink_without_onboarding.note: A permalink opened with empty storage applies the state without starting the tour.

presets.note: Six presets applied through DiagramUI examples: four complete boundaries and two defect scenarios.

learn_mode.note: Four topics and a three-step tour render in en, uk and pl and are attached to the phase and filter fields and to three result tiles.

empty_one_many.note: Empty register, one boundary and a dense 10-package grid recompute with no console error; recompute of 45 boundaries completes inside one second.

stale_recompute.note: Live compute mode recomputes on every state change without a run action.

report_all_languages.note: Report built in en, uk, de, nl, fr, es and pl: 3 A4 pages, 2 figures, 10 sections, zero console errors in each.

report_pagination.note: Three A4 pages with the source footer stamped on each; rendered pages read as images.

report_repeat_scan.note: No body sentence longer than 45 characters appears twice in any of the seven rendered reports.

invalid_tokens.note: Rendered report text contains no undefined, [object Object], NaN or unfilled brace placeholder.

csv_export_scalar.note: CSV export carries one scalar row per package, boundary and item: 33 rows for one boundary, 217 rows for 45 boundaries, zero [object Object].

benchmark_html.note: benchmark.html renders the artifact in all seven languages under the staged PHP catalog and degrades for an unknown, missing or unbenchmarked tool.

console.note: No uncaught page error and no console error during the campaign.
